description: This file defines the LabelInfo class, which manages translation labels with locale-specific values, comments, and associated metadata for internationalization purposes in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LabelInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates information about a label, including its key, comments, filename, and locale-specific label values.

methods.name: LabelInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing LabelInfo with key, comment, filename, locale, value, and comment.

methods.name: getLabelKeyComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the label key.

methods.name: setLabelKeyComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the label key.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the label.

methods.name: getLabelValue
methods.description: Retrieves the LabelValue object for a specified locale.

methods.name: getLabelValueSize
methods.description: Returns the number of locale-specific label values.

methods.name: setLabelValue
methods.description: Sets or updates the label value for a specific locale, optionally updating existing entries or removing them.
